summary: Severe texture pop-in on Level 2 skyscraper assets during high-speed driving.
Player character mesh tearing when equipping the Paladin heavy armor.
Lighting glitches in the subway tunnel causing a severe strobing effect.
Water reflections render completely black on specific AMD GPUs.
Persistent screen tearing during Cutscene 4 regardless of V-Sync settings.
Bullet hole decals floating 2 inches above the ground in the desert map.
Jungle foliage fails to render at medium distances, appearing as green blocks.
Sun lens flare visual artifact persists on screen even after the sun has set.
Character falling through the floor when exiting the Level 3 elevator shaft.
Enemy ragdoll anomalies stretch infinitely across the map when killed by an explosive barrel.
Invisible walls block the player from walking down the alleyway in Sector 7.
Jeep vehicle launches 100 feet into the air upon colliding with a plastic traffic cone.
Grenades bounce back incorrectly off broken window frames, killing the player.
Dropped loot items slide through the terrain when discarded on a grassy slope.
Final boss gets stuck infinitely in a walking animation against the throne pillar.
Player model gets soft-locked inside a supply crate if it closes while looting.
Defeated enemy bodies vibrate violently on the ground due to collision overlap.
Missing sound effects completely when firing the heavy plasma rifle.
Looping helicopter audio glitches continue playing even after the vehicle is destroyed.
Severe voice line desync during the primary villain's monologue in Act 2.
Footstep sounds are entirely missing when the player walks over metal grate surfaces.
Ambient city noise stops abruptly after 5 minutes of remaining in the Hub zone.
Main menu music track overlaps and plays simultaneously with the loading screen music.
Explosion SFX sound heavily muffled and lack bass when detonated indoors.
NPC dialogue volume is mixed far too low compared to background environmental SFX.
Text truncation on the advanced skill tree descriptions for the Russian localization.
Broken menu navigation; player cannot scroll down the inventory list using a controller D-pad.
HUD overlap: The circular mini-map completely covers the active quest tracker UI.
Health bar UI does not visually update immediately after consuming a health potion.
The 'Sort Inventory by Value' button is completely unresponsive when clicked.
White subtitle text color blends into bright skybox backgrounds making it unreadable.
Controller UI prompts incorrectly display PC keyboard icons during the tutorial.
The pause menu freezes the game for 3 full seconds before rendering the UI.
Severe player position desync when entering the passenger seat of a moving vehicle.
Host migration drop causes all remaining clients in the lobby to disconnect to the main menu.
Frequent packet loss disconnects exclusively during maximum capacity 64-player matches.
Hit registration fails completely when shooting at an enemy player with over 150ms ping.
In-game voice chat randomly cuts out for party members in the pre-game lobby.
Ranked matchmaking timer loops indefinitely past 10 minutes without finding a server.
Party leader cannot send new friend invites after completing a single multiplayer match.
Players occasionally spawn under the map coordinates at the start of a Team Deathmatch.
Explosion physics crash near barrel assets.
Hard crash to desktop/dashboard when attempting to load Save Slot 3.
Memory leaks causing the game's frame rate to drop to 10 FPS over 2 hours of continuous play.
System lockups when dynamically changing the display resolution from 1080p to 4K.
Vehicle velocity vector overflows when driving reverse into water body boundary, causing memory corruption crash.
Out of memory hard crash when rapidly spinning the camera in densely populated city areas.
EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION crash triggered during the final boss phase transition cinematic.
Game crashes instantly when disconnecting the controller during a level load screen.
Engine fatal error crash on game startup for users running outdated NVIDIA GPU drivers.
